followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: The Greek customs strike caused observed vehicle restrictions at the two named Albania crossings, supporting the included parent. Cars and buses at Kakavija and Kapshtica. Pedestrian/passenger-without-bags and medical-emergency exceptions remain explicit. The report’s wider strike scope does not independently establish actual closure at Macedonia or Turkey crossings. P1 retains observed vehicle restriction on 30 May 2018 from the reported 07:00 onset, with no actual end. P2 preserves the overlapping planned 30–31 May 07:00–07:00 window. The two phases must not be added, and the planned finish is not observed reopening. The strike mechanism is established but the workers’ specific underlying demands are not. Retain Uncoded / Unresolved rationale rather than infer a socioeconomic demand from the fact of a strike alone. One BalkanWeb report contains named reporters’ observations at the two crossings and the announced union schedule. It is one reporting source, not independent confirmation of a completed 24-hour operational closure. Both phases remain unlocated pending B01. Neither a whole Greek border outline nor a coordinate binding is approved by this audit.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge

followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept the full fixed sample audit of 16 parents and 27 phases, including 29 guarded input-cell corrections and the new Sadao onset question. Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
